content: If development error detection for the Ttcan module is en- abled: The function Can_TTSetExtClockSyncCommand() shall raise the error 29 of 53  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 432: AUTOSAR_SWS_TTCANDriver Specification of TTCAN Driver AUTOSAR CP R19-11 CAN_TT_E_NOT_CURRENT_MASTER if the TTCAN Controller is not the current Time Master .
